verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's first-party hosted MCP server lets users query events, funnels, flows, retention and session replays in natural language without navigating dashboards, and exposes some write actions such as Create-Dashboard. The natural-language operation happens through an external AI assistant connected to that server, and the evidence covers mainly querying rather than operating the full product. missing for 10: a documented in-product natural-language command interface, evidence of natural-language control beyond querying and dashboard creation (e.g., configuration, cohorts, experiments), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the natural-language workflows work as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Once connected, you can query events, funnels, flows, retention, session replays, and more using natural language — no dashboard navigation required.
Mixpanel provides a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that gives AI assistants direct access to your Mixpanel data.
Create-Dashboard | Create a new dashboard with text cards and reports
